mapper.select: SELECT target_id AS articleId, COUNT(*) AS countNum FROM user_like WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND delete_flag = 0 AND target_id IN #{id} GROUP BY target_id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_like(user_id, target_type, target_id, delete_flag, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{deleteFlag}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
